description:
warket is a private watchlist for the assets you follow. Keep lists of stocks, funds, crypto or anything else, with notes, links and tags for each one. No account, no email: your 12 words open your vault, and they never leave your iPhone.

ORGANIZE
• Lists for every idea, theme or strategy, shown as a grid or a list
• For each asset: name, ticker, image, tags, a short summary and longer notes with simple formatting
• Links to the articles, reports and pages that matter, with their titles fetched for you
• Drag to reorder lists and assets

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no name, no email
• warket makes 12 words for you. They are the key to your vault and never leave your iPhone
• Your vault is stored on the warket server under a fingerprint of that key, kept apart from every other vault
• No ads, no analytics, no tracking

SHARE AND MOVE
• Give someone a read-only share key: they can look, never change anything
• Open the same vault on the website with the same 12 words
• Export your vault to a file and import it any time
• Delete your vault from the server whenever you want

WHAT WARKET IS NOT
warket is a notebook, not a broker or a wallet. It shows no prices, makes no trades, holds no money or coins, connects to no blockchain and gives no financial advice. The 12 words only open your notes.

Keep your 12 words somewhere safe. Nobody can reset them, not even us.
promotionalText: Keep your investment ideas in one private place. Lists, notes, links and tags for every asset you follow. No account, no email: just 12 words that stay on your iPhone.
